entries.symptom: Validator asserts a historical/future vendor version label while authoritative integration evidence has changed.
entries.prevention: Assert capability, protocol and evidence semantics rather than brittle version prose.
entries.permanentGuard: development proof preflight + semantic integration validator

entries.symptom: A test reads a generated report/file that is not committed or packaged into the exact candidate.
entries.prevention: Proof reads the effective runtime registry directly unless the generated artifact is itself admitted and packaged.
entries.permanentGuard: preflight resolves every local new URL(..., import.meta.url) dependency before expensive proof

entries.symptom: Security fixture uses a retired source type alias not accepted by hardened runtime trust boundaries.
entries.prevention: Tests use canonical registered source families and fail if retired aliases reappear.

entries.symptom: Test asserts an obsolete aggregate URL after the public artifact contract split into explicit video/caption/transcript URLs.
entries.prevention: Tests assert current public contract fields and no hidden compatibility field.

entries.symptom: Later research overlay replaces nested verified evidence/value objects, silently losing prior mappings.
entries.prevention: Nested objects merge recursively while arrays remain explicit replacements.
entries.permanentGuard: preflight verifies mergePatch exists and rejects the retired shallow merge implementation

entries.symptom: Proof never reaches product/test execution because runner/builder allocation fails.
entries.prevention: Classify provider degradation separately and route the exact SHA to the next executable proof lane.
